title: Checkout rebuild — acceptance pass · round 2
subtitle: Three open points from round 1, and the one you added
intro: In round 2 I changed what did not work, and I ask again where your answer left it open. Guest checkout, which works, is settled.

createdBy.note: Derived from the acceptance criteria in issue #218.

options.label: Partially works
options.hint: Completes, but not the way it should

sections.label: The path most people take
sections.description: If any of these are wrong, nothing below matters.

sections.label: Where it usually breaks
sections.description: Declines, timeouts, and the back button.

nodes.label: Says why the card was declined
Back pressed: charged once at most

items.title: A returning customer can pay with a saved card

fields.expect: Card shown masked, one tap to pay.

items.reply: Changed: the saved card is now chosen by default, and a second card can be picked from the list.
items.summary: The saved card is chosen by default; another card can be picked from the list.

items.title: A declined card explains itself
items.body: Use the test card that always declines.

fields.expect: Plain-language reason, cart intact, retry without re-entering the address.
fields.watch: A raw gateway error code reaching the customer.

items.reply: Changed: error 51 now reads "Your bank declined this card: not enough funds", and the cart is kept.
items.summary: A declined card says why, in words, and the cart stays as it was.

items.title: The back button mid-payment does not double-charge

fields.expect: One charge, one order, whatever the customer does.

items.reply: You did not get to this one last time, so I ask again.

items.title: Currency switches halfway through
items.summary: The price now stays in the currency the customer started with, from the cart to the receipt.
items.reply: Fixed, as you raised: the currency is fixed when the cart is created.
